title: Report an unknown item
summary: REST API Development: Report an unknown item. Write a useful message for an unknown author.
introduction: 404 means the requested resource was not found. A short error body can help a client explain the problem.
learningObjectives: Report an unknown item with REST API Development
Write a useful message for an unknown author

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Report an unknown item
blocks.code:
GET /books/99 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test

HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"Book not found"}

blocks.text: The path names a resource the server cannot find. The response status and error body both describe that failure.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: The API reports a missing book with status 404.

blocks.text: Write a useful message for an unknown author.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not return 200 for every outcome; clients use status codes.
